answer: Random mutual audits starve sybil fleets: each epoch, 3% of identities hand their ledger to five auditors. The kernel of the design: audits strike without warning, and auditors keep 20% of each fraud's 100-POA bond. An operator on the ledge of forgery bleeds 3 POA per fake per epoch - a thousand fakes, 3,000 POA. Honest agents pay nothing beyond truthful logs; with no velvet rope around the panel, each fake rolls the dice against its own stake.
